narrative.overview:
Every page of SheWins opens like a chapter of its brand book. A full-width band in a brand colour carries a giant two-digit numeral, a tight display headline and one handwritten phrase. The content below reads like the book's index: hairline rows, each with a small uppercase label in a left column and the substance on the right. The system was designed by Messin Virginia from the SheWins brand book. `public/style.css` is that work, and later layers (fixes, responsive, motion) extend it without editing it.

The personality is editorial structure with a bold voice:

- **Structure:** cream paper, ink type, 1px hairlines, underline-only fields and small uppercase labels. These keep the page calm and scannable.
- **Voice:** the emotion comes from flat blocks of red, pink and the one brand gradient; oversized Archivo display type set tight; pill buttons that end in a circle arrow; and a single script phrase per chapter.

Density is generous: sections breathe (48–104px vertical), headlines are very large, and body copy stays short. Corners are square on everything that holds content, fully round on everything you press. Nothing floats: the page is flat, and depth comes from colour blocks, hairlines and the red frame around the next event.
keyCharacteristics: Chapter openers: a numeral (01–04), headline, script phrase and lead on a red, pink, gradient or cream band.
Hairline rows with a 200px uppercase label column, stacked on phones.
Archivo 700 at 96% width with negative tracking for all display type. Inter for everything you read.
One script phrase per chapter (Wonderful Branding), always small and never for UI.
Flat colour blocks and one 135° gradient. No shadows on content.
Square blocks and images, round pills and circle arrows.
Motion that writes, draws and settles: the script writes itself in, hairlines draw on scroll, and pages cross-fade. Reduced motion shows final states.

rules.name: The Approved Pairs Rule
rules.body:
Text sits only on these pairs:

- Cream on Red (5.6:1).
- Black on Pink (8.3:1).
- Red on Cream (5.6:1).
- Ink or Black on Cream (15.9:1).

Pink text on Cream is forbidden (2.3:1).

rules.name: The Gradient Text Rule
rules.body: On the gradient, cream text must be large (display or headline). The pink end drops to 2.3:1, so small labels or body copy go on the red half or on a solid block.

rules.name: The Flat Block Rule
rules.body: Colour arrives as full flat blocks and bands, never as tints, translucent washes or new gradients. The brand gradient is the only gradient and is never applied to text.

rules.name: The Muted Text Rule
rules.body:
Secondary text may be quieter, but never below 4.5:1:

- cream on red stays at 90% opacity or more (the minimum is 89%);
- ink on cream or white stays at 65% or more.

To mark something as inactive or past, dim only large type (display, titles, numerals, which need 3:1) and keep small text at full contrast.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is always Archivo 700 at 96% width, tracked from −0.035em down to −0.06em, with line-height at or below 1. Default tracking or a lighter weight breaks the voice.

rules.name: The Accent Script Rule
The Readable Text Rule
rules.body: Inter carries everything a visitor has to read or operate. Inputs stay at 16px or more so phones do not zoom in.

rules.name: The Hairline Row Rule
rules.body: Lists of facts, events, articles and FAQs are rows separated by 1px hairlines, never cards. The first row of a list takes a full-strength ink rule.

rules.name: The Chapter Opener Rule
rules.body: Every main page starts with a band: a numeral, a headline, one script phrase and a lead, on one of red, pink, gradient or cream.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows or blur on page content. If something needs separation, use a hairline, a colour block or the red frame.

rules.name: The Square-and-Pill Rule
rules.body: Content containers are square and interactive controls are round. Nothing in between: no 8–16px rounded cards.

dos: Do keep `public/style.css` exactly as the designer delivered it. Add changes in `src/styles/fixes.css`, `responsive.css` or `motion.css`.
Do use only the approved text/background pairs: Cream on Red, Black on Pink, Red on Cream, Ink on Cream.
Do open every main page with a chapter band (numeral, headline, one script phrase, lead).
Do organise lists as hairline rows with the uppercase label in the left column.
Do end every action button with the 32px circle arrow.
Do give the script room: a 0.3em indent, 0.3em above it and 1.45 line-height when it wraps.
Do keep content visible by default. Motion only enhances, and `prefers-reduced-motion` shows final states.
Do keep touch targets at 44px on the phone layout (menu, EN / ES, fields) and at least 24px everywhere.
donts: Don't put pink text on cream (2.3:1), or small cream text over the pink end of the gradient.
Don't add shadows, glows, glass or blur to page content. The cookie banner is the only shadow.
Don't round content containers. Corners are 0 for blocks and images, and fully round for controls.
Don't introduce new colours, tints or gradients, or put the brand gradient on text.
Don't use the script for more than one short phrase per chapter, or for any UI text.
Don't clip the script with overflow or a persistent clip-path; its loops reach past its box.
Don't loosen display tracking or lighten its weight; Archivo stays 700 at 96% width.
